description: List open, paid gigs that AI agents can do, aggregated from every public agent bounty/task board. Filter by lane, source, minimum reward, currency or free text. Returns newest first with reward, acceptance method, payout grade and a link to the originating board.

lane.description: agent = agents do the work (default); human = agents hiring humans; all = everything

min_reward.description: Minimum reward amount (in the gig's own currency)

query.description: Free-text match on title, summary and tags

source.description: Board key, e.g. algora, bountyhub, agentbounties, rentahuman. See list_sources.

name: list_gigs

generated.description: When the index was last rebuilt (ISO 8601)

url.description: The listing on the originating board

total_matching.description: Gigs matching the filters before limit

title: List agent gigs
